headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty faced pressure amid weak global cues, with Paytm and IPO listings taking center stage.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Crude oil price fluctuations and Middle East conflicts weighed on investor risk appetite.
FII trading activity remained cautious, keeping benchmark indices under pressure.
Global tech hiring concerns due to rapid AI adoption impacted general tech sentiment.
Nifty navigated a potential inflection point after persistent weak returns over recent years.
whatHappening: NSE IPO grey market premium (GMP) dropped to its lowest level since announcement.
Paytm stays in focus as traders evaluate stock outlook ahead of the new week.
Market participants are monitoring GIFT Nifty, Nikkei, and Kospi for opening cues.
Indices are expected to seek support in the upcoming September 21-25 trading sessions.
summary:
During the last session, Indian equities tracked cautious global markets amid Middle East tensions and FII outflows.
Key stocks like Paytm remain in focus, while primary market sentiment cooled as IPO grey market premiums fell.
Investors are closely watching GIFT Nifty and Asian peers for direction ahead of Monday's market opening.
